hoist.headline: Teaching humanoids to guide the lift.
hoist.title: One load. A coordinated lift.
hoist.imageAlt: Author-recorded humanoid guiding a suspended box toward a marked laboratory target.
hoist.sceneAlt: Future concept: a crane suspends a load between a crew member and a humanoid beside an unfinished structure.
hoist.description: The current work demonstrates humanoid guidance of one suspended box in controlled laboratory and simulation settings. Three open connections—adaptive contact, coordination with lifting equipment, and integration into site operations—lead toward a future coordinated lift. The illustration places a humanoid and a crew member beside a crane-suspended load and an unfinished structure. It is a collaborative concept, not evidence of a field-deployed system.
